question: How do I work with trip todos?

sections.title: Add, update, or delete personal trip todos
items: Open the toolbar Trip menu and select Trips.
Select the trip you want to work in.
Open the toolbar Trip menu again and select Todos.
Use Add to create a trip todo, Update to edit the selected todo, or Delete to remove the selected todo.
sections.afterHtml: These are trip-specific todos. They belong to the selected trip, not to your reusable Todos dictionary.

sections.title: See shared assignment status on accepted shared todos
items: If a todo came from an accepted shared todo assignment, Plantour shows assignment status details in the list.
The status text can show whether the shared todo was assigned, accepted, finished successfully, finished with failure, and whether there is a deadline.
sections.afterHtml: Use the page menu to switch between Show Assignments and Hide Assignments if you want to show or hide that assignment-related status area.

sections.title: Finish accepted shared todos
sections.beforeHtml: When a shared todo was assigned to you and accepted, it appears in your trip todos list as your working copy.
items: Find the accepted shared todo in Trip Todos.
Use Finished success when you completed it successfully.
Use Finished failure when you finished it but the result failed or needs admin attention.
Plantour updates the assignment status text so the trip and shared workflow reflect the new state.
sections.afterHtml: For the full assignment flow, continue with the Shared trip workflows help section.
